title: Term structure shapes in the Hull-White model with Svensson-parameterized initial yield curves
abstract: arXiv:2608.12016v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We examine the shapes attainable by the forward and yield curve in the Hull-White model with Svensson-parameterized initial yield curves. For Nelson-Siegel-parameterized initial yield curves, we provide a complete classification of all attainable shapes and partition the parameter space and the state space according to these shapes. Our analysis relies on the theory of Tchebycheff systems and the envelope method. For Bliss- and Svensson-parameterized initial yield curves, we derive lower and upper bounds on the number of attainable local extrema. We examine the asymptotic behavior of the model and demonstrate that the yield curve attains only the shapes normal, inverse and humped with positive probability as $t\rightarrow\infty.$

translated_title: Hull-White模型下具有Svensson参数化初始收益率曲线的期限结构形状
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们研究了在具有Svensson参数化初始收益率曲线的Hull-White模型中，远期曲线和收益率曲线可达到的形状。对于Nelson-Siegel参数化的初始收益率曲线，我们提供了所有可达到形状的完整分类，并根据这些形状对参数空间和状态空间进行了划分。我们的分析依赖于切比雪夫系统理论和包络方法。对于Bliss和Svensson参数化的初始收益率曲线，我们推导了可达到的局部极值数量的上下界。我们研究了模型的渐近行为，并证明当t趋向无穷大时，收益率曲线仅以正概率达到正常、倒挂和驼峰形状。
tldr: 该论文对Hull-White模型在不同参数化初始收益率曲线下的期限结构形状进行了完整分类，并揭示了其渐近行为。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a complete classification of term structure shapes in the Hull-White model with various parameterized initial yield curves and reveals their asymptotic behavior.
